deltaFailureClassification.scope: Read-only classification of same failing invocation; no fresh motion run, no input/tolerance change or physical accuracy claim
deltaFailureClassification.observation: Two main-MCU batches of20 future pulses were received after the synthetic count injection and before main stop; requested first pulse is later than stop. Delta test increments entire batch on reception, whereas C queue schedules pulses and position query subtracts unexecuted pulses. This demonstrates a receive-counter confound in the failing test; does not prove physical motion/kernel correctness.
deltaFailureClassification.decision: Next: bounded commanded-clock counter model that drops unexecuted pulses on observed stop, preserve original inputs and1e-10 checks, validate with independent C semantics. Do not force equal tower counts at trigger or modify runtime math.
